Imaging pattern and biopsy findings

raw_support_spans.text: The radiologist noted that the lesion appeared to originate from the stomach and suggested a gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST).

Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT showed a 5.5 cm × 4.3 cm smoothly marginated soft-tissue mass in the gastric wall protruding beyond the serosal contour, with marked enhancement and surrounding lymph-node enlargement (nodes up to 1.0 cm). Malignancy, including GIST with nodal metastases, could not be excluded.
